evidence.detail: update_cards() runs apply_rules_query() scoped to a single rule_id; this CTE joins rule_card, deck, and deck_card across the entire deck corpus
apply_rules_query() is a multi-CTE query: rule_card_count → candidates (deck × deck_card join) → exclusion check; slow for large datasets
No fixing commits found; author comments show latency improved with innodb_file_buffer change then crept back to 7s+

triage.notes: Root cause is the CTE in apply_rules_query joining deck and deck_card for all decks to re-match one rule. Indexing on deck_card(card, sideboard, n) or limiting the deck set searched might help, but profiling is needed before picking a fix.
